schemas.name: Decision
schemas.purpose_statement: A call a human made — the choice, its rationale, and outcome — kept as an auditable trail

field_descriptions.knowledge_record_slug: the stable slug that identifies a knowledge record within its record type
field_descriptions.knowledge_record_title: the one-line title of a knowledge record
field_descriptions.knowledge_record_markdown: the Markdown text of a knowledge record
field_descriptions.knowledge_record_status: the lifecycle status of a knowledge record, interpreted by its record type
field_descriptions.north_star_slug: the slug of the North Star that owns the outcome; empty when no North Star is assigned
field_descriptions.decision_gate_slug: the slug of the decision gate that a decision clears; empty when no gate is assigned
field_descriptions.decision_maker_identifier: the person or agent identifier supplied as the maker of a decision
field_descriptions.decision_date_text: the date text supplied by the decision author; an empty value denotes no supplied date
field_descriptions.knowledge_record_tag_labels: the freeform tag labels attached to a knowledge record
field_descriptions.knowledge_record_created_at: the RFC 3339 instant when a knowledge record was created
field_descriptions.knowledge_record_updated_at: the RFC 3339 instant when a knowledge record was last updated

schemas.name: TagIndex
schemas.purpose_statement: Inverted index mapping a tag to the records that carry it, maintained by fbrain to make tag-filtered reads scale with tag cardinality instead of corpus size

field_descriptions.tag_lookup_key: the key __tagidx__ followed by the lowercase SHA-256 digest of a tag label
field_descriptions.tag_label: the complete text label of a tag
field_descriptions.tagged_record_references: the knowledge record references encoded as type:slug that carry a tag
field_descriptions.tag_membership_list_created_at: the RFC 3339 instant when a tag membership list was created
field_descriptions.tag_membership_list_updated_at: the RFC 3339 instant when a tag membership list was last updated

schemas.name: TagMembership
schemas.purpose_statement: Per-member rows of the fbrain tag and backlink membership layout: one row names one record that carries one tag or links to one target, so adding or removing a member is a single small write and a read is a keyed partition read

field_descriptions.tag_membership_bucket_key: the key __tagidx__ followed by the lowercase SHA-256 digest of a tag or link-target label
field_descriptions.tag_membership_entry_key: the type:slug membership reference, or a reserved double-underscore key for copy state
field_descriptions.tag_label_excerpt: the first 1 KiB of a tag label, for display only
field_descriptions.tag_membership_copy_state_json: a JSON-encoded legacy membership copy stamp or short-lived copy claim

schemas.name: BrainAdminSnapshot
schemas.purpose_statement: Privacy-safe fbrain admin dashboard rollup for delivery as a LastDB slice; stores counts and short summaries only, never full brain bodies or secrets

field_descriptions.knowledge_snapshot_id: the stable identifier of a knowledge metadata snapshot
field_descriptions.snapshot_producer_app_id: the app identifier of the producer of a metadata snapshot
field_descriptions.snapshot_schema_version_text: the text version of the payload contract of a metadata snapshot
field_descriptions.snapshot_captured_at: the RFC 3339 instant when a metadata snapshot was captured
field_descriptions.knowledge_record_type_counts_json: a JSON-encoded object with one live knowledge record count for each record type
field_descriptions.open_decision_list_json: a JSON-encoded list of open decision slugs and titles
field_descriptions.active_program_summary_list_json: a JSON-encoded list of summaries of active programs
field_descriptions.recent_heartbeat_event_list_json: a JSON-encoded list of recent heartbeat event identifiers, times and outcomes

schemas.name: BrainAttachmentIndex
schemas.purpose_statement: Per-record list of file attachments on an fbrain knowledge record; filename metadata is searchable, attachment content is not

field_descriptions.attachment_lookup_key: the attachment-list key __attidx__ followed by the SHA-256 digest of the owning record type and slug
field_descriptions.knowledge_record_type: the record type that names one kind of knowledge record
field_descriptions.knowledge_record_slug: the stable slug that identifies a knowledge record within its record type
field_descriptions.attachment_file_names: the file names attached to a knowledge record
field_descriptions.attachment_metadata_list_json: a JSON-encoded list of attachment names, file references, sizes, media types and added times
field_descriptions.attachment_list_created_at: the RFC 3339 instant when an attachment metadata list was created
field_descriptions.attachment_list_updated_at: the RFC 3339 instant when an attachment metadata list was last updated

schemas.name: BrainAttachmentBlob
schemas.purpose_statement: Content-addressed file bytes backing fbrain attachments; binary payload intentionally excluded from all search indexes

field_descriptions.file_content_sha256_hex: the lowercase SHA-256 hexadecimal digest of the bytes of a file
field_descriptions.file_size_bytes_decimal_text: the base-10 text encoding of a file size in bytes
field_descriptions.file_media_type: the MIME type of a file
field_descriptions.file_content_base64: the base64 encoding of the complete bytes of a file
field_descriptions.file_record_created_at: the RFC 3339 instant when a file metadata record was first stored

schemas.name: BrainAttachmentFile
schemas.purpose_statement: Content-addressed record backing an fbrain attachment; the bytes are the record's own LastDB file, never a field value

field_descriptions.file_content_sha256_hex: the lowercase SHA-256 hexadecimal digest of the bytes of a file
field_descriptions.file_size_bytes_decimal_text: the base-10 text encoding of a file size in bytes
field_descriptions.file_media_type: the MIME type of a file
field_descriptions.file_record_created_at: the RFC 3339 instant when a file metadata record was first stored

schemas.name: BrainBodyFile
schemas.purpose_statement: Sidecar whose LastDB file holds the full long text of one fbrain record field (body, papercut evidence); the record keeps only a bounded head and a marker line

field_descriptions.knowledge_text_file_lookup_key: the key __bodyfile__ followed by the SHA-256 digest of source record type, slug and local field name
field_descriptions.knowledge_record_type: the record type that names one kind of knowledge record
field_descriptions.knowledge_record_slug: the stable slug that identifies a knowledge record within its record type
field_descriptions.knowledge_text_source_local_field_name: the app-local name of the knowledge record field whose text is held in this file
field_descriptions.file_content_sha256_hex: the lowercase SHA-256 hexadecimal digest of the bytes of a file
field_descriptions.file_size_bytes_decimal_text: the base-10 text encoding of a file size in bytes
field_descriptions.knowledge_text_file_created_at: the RFC 3339 instant when a knowledge text file was first stored
field_descriptions.knowledge_text_file_updated_at: the RFC 3339 instant when a knowledge text file was last replaced

schemas.name: BrainListPage
schemas.purpose_statement: One thin list page for brain list, addressed by a list hash and a page id, holding card ids and a short title and no body

field_descriptions.knowledge_list_scope_key: the selector for a knowledge list by type, status, tag, parent design, link target or symptom; all selects the complete list
field_descriptions.knowledge_list_page_key: the __head__ marker or a knowledge list page identifier p followed by eight digits
field_descriptions.knowledge_list_page_json: a JSON-encoded knowledge list page with short record summaries and an older page identifier; no record body

schemas.name: BrainListLocator
schemas.purpose_statement: One locator that names the single list page holding one brain card, so a put rewrites that page without walking the chain

field_descriptions.knowledge_list_locator_scope_key: the locator scope token loc# followed by the knowledge list hash
field_descriptions.knowledge_list_record_reference: a knowledge record reference encoded as type#slug within one list locator
field_descriptions.knowledge_list_record_page_id: the page identifier assigned to one knowledge record in a particular list

schemas.name: BrainCompactListLocator_v1
schemas.purpose_statement: One exact compact list-locator value addressed by the digest of its list and card identity; no ordered range

field_descriptions.knowledge_list_record_page_id: the page identifier assigned to one knowledge record in a particular list

schemas.name: BrainTypeDirectory
schemas.purpose_statement: One directory record per slug that lists which brain record types use that slug

field_descriptions.knowledge_record_slug: the stable slug that identifies a knowledge record within its record type
field_descriptions.knowledge_type_directory_marker: the fixed __types__ range marker of a knowledge record type directory
field_descriptions.knowledge_record_type_list_json: a JSON-encoded list of the knowledge record types that use one record slug

schemas.name: BrainListCount
schemas.purpose_statement: One decimal counter for the whole brain list or for one record type, not for a status, a tag, or a time window

field_descriptions.knowledge_count_scope_key: the count scope token all or one knowledge record type name
field_descriptions.knowledge_record_count_decimal_text: the base-10 text encoding of a count of knowledge records within a named count scope

schemas.name: BrainEdgeSet
schemas.purpose_statement: One capped set of graph-edge ids for a brain record, so a neighbor read does not range-read the out edge schema

field_descriptions.knowledge_edge_set_scope_key: the edge-set scope key es# followed by a knowledge record type and slug
field_descriptions.knowledge_edge_set_head_marker: the fixed __head__ range marker of a knowledge edge set
field_descriptions.knowledge_edge_reference_list_json: a JSON-encoded list of at most sixteen edge references encoded as type#destination

schemas.name: BrainTokenSet
schemas.purpose_statement: One capped token list for a brain record. An absent record reads as an empty token list. Keyword pages are a later write

field_descriptions.knowledge_token_set_scope_key: the token-set scope key ts# followed by a knowledge record type and slug
field_descriptions.knowledge_token_set_head_marker: the fixed __head__ range marker of a knowledge token set
field_descriptions.knowledge_token_list_json: a JSON-encoded list of at most eight tokens written by a knowledge record

schemas.name: BrainBackfillCursor
schemas.purpose_statement: One cursor for a named-slug list backfill. The record stores the last source slug and the count added for that slug

field_descriptions.knowledge_backfill_scope_key: the backfill scope key bf# followed by the target list hash and source record type
field_descriptions.knowledge_backfill_cursor_marker: the fixed __cursor__ range marker of a knowledge list backfill
field_descriptions.knowledge_backfill_cursor_json: a JSON-encoded backfill cursor with the last source slug and count added for that slug
